uutiset.t: Senegal fans celebrate AFCON legal victory over Morocco
uutiset.s: Senegal have been reinstated as 2025 AFCON champions after the Court of Arbitration for Sport upheld their appeal.

uutiset.t: Israel’s Eisenkot secures first coalition partner in bid to form government
uutiset.s: The Yashar party says it agreed to sign a coalition pact with Israel's Our Home party, led by Avigdor Lieberman.

uutiset.t: Iran whips singer Parastoo Ahmadi 74 times over YouTube concert
uutiset.s: Iranian authorities have lashed singer Parastoo Ahmadi over a 2024 performance streamed live on YouTube.

uutiset.t: Poll finds US voters want government to end Iran war regardless of terms
uutiset.s: New survey finds that 55 percent of voters, including 80 percent of Democrats, want war brought to an end immediately.

uutiset.t: Gunmen hold dozens hostage in Colombia supermarket
uutiset.s: A group of armed men is holding around 20 people hostage in Cartagena, Colombia.

uutiset.t: Alaska ends deal to give voter records to US Justice Department
uutiset.s: The decision follows the conclusion of the 2026 midterm elections and an effort under Trump to gather state voter rolls.

uutiset.t: Iran war live: Houthis threaten Saudi ports over coalition’s Hodeidah order
uutiset.s: Houthis vow to target Jeddah and other Saudi ports if Hodeidah is hit, after the coalition issues an evacuation order.

uutiset.t: Rebel group retreats in DR Congo after heavy clashes with government forces
uutiset.s: CRP halts advance towards Bunia, citing commitments made during Ugandan-mediated talks with government.

uutiset.t: South Africa convicts Zimbabwean who tried to fight Ukraine for Russia
uutiset.s: The Zimbabwean man was arrested on November 8 at a Johannesburg airport while attempting to board a flight to Russia.

uutiset.t: Arsenal and Dortmund draw 1-1 as Gyokeres goes from hero to villain
uutiset.s: Arsenal dominate the chances as Borussia Dortmund fight back for a 1-1 draw in football's Champions League.

uutiset.t: Bellingham stunner, Mbappe brace help Real Madrid rout PSV
uutiset.s: Real Madrid come from behind to power past PSV Eindhoven with a 5-1 win in football's Champions League.

uutiset.t: Todd Blanche declines to confirm if Nvidia’s Jensen Huang was investigated
uutiset.s: The US attorney general refused to discuss claims by Donald Trump that his administration conducted a 'thorough' probe.

uutiset.t: Colombian president blames ex-FARC rebels for car bomb blast
uutiset.s: Colombian President De la Espriella blames the FARC for plotting a bombing that injured tens and pledges to retaliate.

uutiset.t: China’s Huawei found guilty of trade secrets conspiracy, fraud in US trial
uutiset.s: Jurors acquit the company of the most serious charge it faced of engaging in a criminal racketeering conspiracy.

uutiset.t: Russian jets spark air raid alert in South Korea
uutiset.s: South Korea’s residents were urged to seek shelter as Russian military jets approached its airspace on Tuesday.
